rationale: The next bounded milestone should convert post-v0.13 source audits, link repair records, and cross-source provenance controls into a release-wide, reproducible integrity layer. The name does not claim source truth or comprehensive scientific validation.

observed_post_v013_work.note: These are candidate inputs, not by themselves proof of v0.14 readiness.

proposed_required_criteria.criterion: Release-scoped external URL inventory exists and deterministically enumerates every source included in the v0.14 public release boundary.
proposed_required_criteria.pass_condition: Inventory validator reports complete coverage with stable source IDs and preserved original URLs.

proposed_required_criteria.criterion: Every inventoried URL has retrieval metadata and a machine-readable status that distinguishes available, redirected, unavailable, rate-limited, and unchecked.
proposed_required_criteria.pass_condition: No missing status; unavailable or changed sources are not classified as false.

proposed_required_criteria.criterion: Redirects and changed titles retain original values alongside observed values; replacements are explicit repair candidates with approval records.
proposed_required_criteria.pass_condition: Validator finds no silent URL or title replacement.

proposed_required_criteria.criterion: Duplicate references are linked by normalized work keys without collapsing distinct provenance contexts.
proposed_required_criteria.pass_condition: Duplicate/linkage validator passes and produces no provenance-loss error.

proposed_required_criteria.criterion: Retraction and withdrawal metadata is recorded where applicable without automatically changing claim truth status.
proposed_required_criteria.pass_condition: Applicable scholarly records are checked or explicitly marked unchecked; no automatic truth inference occurs.

proposed_required_criteria.criterion: GitHub canonical records and AkashicNET.org release-scoped source displays are synchronized.
proposed_required_criteria.pass_condition: Deterministic comparison passes, or every difference is explicitly approved and documented.

proposed_required_criteria.criterion: Cross-source graph relationships preserve edge-level provenance and separate asserted links from inferred candidates.
proposed_required_criteria.pass_condition: Anchor-evidence and qualification validators pass with no circular confidence amplification.

proposed_required_criteria.criterion: Privacy, rights, evidence, and promotion controls remain fail-closed.
proposed_required_criteria.pass_condition: Truth inference, scientific-evidence promotion, rights promotion, and private-Drive promotion are all false; privacy tests pass.

proposed_required_criteria.criterion: All required validators execute successfully at one exact candidate commit.
proposed_required_criteria.pass_condition: Required CI checks are green at the candidate SHA; skipped required checks fail readiness.

proposed_required_criteria.criterion: A reproducible v0.14 release manifest and an append-only release-ledger entry are reviewed before sealing.
proposed_required_criteria.pass_condition: Manifest is CANDIDATE first; ledger append occurs only after explicit approval and validation.

release_blockers: No release-wide external URL coverage manifest currently proves the audit denominator.
No exact v0.14 candidate commit has passed the complete proposed validator set.
No v0.14 release manifest or approved append-only release-ledger entry exists.
exclusions: This proposal does not declare or seal v0.14.
It does not imply that unavailable or changed sources are false.
It does not promote community material or speculative content to scientific evidence.
It does not grant reuse rights.
It does not publish private Drive identifiers, paths, timestamps, or file-linked hashes.

decision_required.question: Approve the milestone name 'Provenance Integrity Beta' and criteria V014-C1 through V014-C10 as the v0.14 readiness contract?
decision_required.effect_of_approval: Authorizes creation of the readiness schema/validator and coverage inventory; does not authorize release promotion or sealing.
